scenarios.name: real_extension_native_consent_revocation
scenarios.title: Honor real Chrome native debugger cancellation across reconnect and worker restart
scenarios.workflow: Authenticate dedicated main page -> preserve unrelated tab -> click Chrome Cancel through native X11 -> refuse input -> close revoked main -> restart worker -> compare real CLI connect/reconnect/navigation/new-tab errors and stored event time -> invoke native extension shortcut -> fresh visible blank page and new session in same profile -> fence old drivers -> read authenticated HTTP state without submitting -> keep unrelated tab and healthy action idempotent
scenarios.user_problem: A user's explicit cancellation must never be undone by automatic recovery or implicit page creation.

steps.description: Click real native Cancel, close and restart, then explicitly authorize through Chrome and inspect same-profile authenticated read and screenshots
